# JHB Automations

> JHB Automations is an AI automation agency and IT solutions and digital marketing company based in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. The company helps businesses automate operations, generate leads, improve digital visibility, build websites and applications, and scale through AI automation and data-driven digital marketing.
